title: CDF successor recurrence
statement: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\mathrm{Fin}\,m$, and let $n \in \mathrm{Fin}\,m$. Then the cumulative distribution function satisfies $\mathrm{cdf}(p, n+1) = \mathrm{cdf}(p, n) + p(n)$, where the sums are taken as extended non-negative reals in $\bbr_{\ge 0}^\infty$.
replaced:
For any PMF $p$ on $\mathrm{Fin}\,m$ and index $n \in \mathrm{Fin}\,m$,
$\mathrm{cdf}(p, n+1) = \mathrm{cdf}(p, n) + p(n)$.
